champion.tips: AATROX TIPS AND TRICKS Try and play around your Passive and trade when its up. Don’t look for an extended fight unless your Passive is up otherwise you’ll miss out on extra damage. You can use your E to reposition your Q sweet spots. This includes using your E forwards, backwards and even left or right. When playing against ranged champions like Syndra, Taliyah and Twisted Fate, make sure you respect their range advantage and be prepared to sacrifice some CS for health. If you’re low on health, you’ll have no pressure.
champion.builds: THE BEST AATROX BUILDS, RUNES AND ITEMS FOR MID IN EMERALD + Most Popular If you want to use the most popular Aatrox Mid build, you should take Flash and Teleport as your Summoner Spells. For runes, you should pick Conqueror as your keystone, followed by Triumph, Legend: Haste and Last Stand in the primary tree, as well as Bone Plating and Revitalize in the secondary tree. For rune shards, you want Adaptive Force in offense, Adaptive Force in flex and Health Scaling in defense, though it depends on the matchup. Finally, for your items, you should build Eclipse as your first item, followed by Mercury's Treads and Sundered Sky. For your last 3 items, you should build Spear of Shojin, Death's Dance and finish with Spirit Visage. For the skill order, you want to stick with Q - E - W. Right now, this build has 50.3% winrate over 195 matches played. Alternative If you're looking for alternatives, you can use Flash and Teleport as your Summoner Spells, with runes being Conqueror as your keystone, Triumph, Legend: Haste and Last Stand in the primary tree, and Bone Plating with Revitalize in the secondary tree, as well as Adaptive Force, Adaptive Force, and Health Scaling as your rune shards. The items that this build incorporates are Sundered Sky as your first item, then Plated Steelcaps as a second item and Spear of Shojin as a third item. You want to finish the build with Death's Dance, Serylda's Grudge and Sterak's Gage. As far as ability max order goes, you want to keep it Q - E - W. This build is currently sitting at a 50.4% win rate across 133 matches played. Off-Meta If you want to try an Off-Meta Aatrox Mid build in the current patch, try Flash and Teleport as your Summoner Spells, Conqueror, Triumph, Legend: Haste and Last Stand as your primary rune tree, and Bone Plating with Revitalize as your secondary tree. Use Adaptive Force, Adaptive Force and Health Scaling as your shards. For items in this build, you want to complete Voltaic Cyclosword as your first item, then finish Mercury's Treads as your second item, and Sundered Sky as third item. The last 3 options are Serylda's Grudge, Death's Dance and Spear of Shojin. The ability order for this build is Q - E - W. As of the current patch, this build has a 41.7% win rate over 60 matches played. Situational Aatrox Runes and Items Depending on the context of your game, your matchup, and enemy champions, you might want to consider building some situational items or take specific runes. Carefully examine your team, enemy team, game state , and your matchup to plan your Aatrox build accordingly! For example, when it comes to rune shards, you might want to take either Armor or Magic Resist, depending on which champion you are about to lane against. Furthermore, if you want a more detailed breakdown, you should also check out Aatrox runes page.
